overview: The file consists solely of a 1976 General Services Administration withdrawal notice documenting the removal of a misfiled, security-classified item from the State Department decimal files. The missing item was designated 896.911/2-2349, numbered A-82, dated February 23, 1949, and sent from Manila; its filing designation and the file title indicate that it concerned the Philippine press or newspapers. The notice does not preserve the contents of the withdrawn document or identify its intended recipient.

subfiles.title: Withdrawal notice for classified despatch A-82 from Manila
subfiles.about: The form records the withdrawal on security-classification grounds of a misfiled item dated February 23, 1949, from Manila.
subfiles.summary: This notice identifies the removed item as file designation 896.911/2-2349 and document A-82, dated February 23, 1949, from Manila. It states that access is restricted because the item contains security-classified information and notes that the document was misfiled in this box. The withdrawal was recorded on March 30, 1976, with the initials CJA and MKW; no recipient or substantive contents of the original item are given.

interest: The notice is useful chiefly as evidence of archival handling and restriction practices rather than for the substance of the original report. It establishes that a security-classified document from Manila concerning the Philippine press was once present, was considered misfiled, and had been removed by 1976. Its precise file designation, document number, date, and origin may enable a historian to trace the missing item through other archival series, withdrawal files, or later declassification releases.
